titulo.estudio: Une annonce de formation : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: A training advert: Finding the details

intro: Find requirements, dates and format in a course advert. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Find requirements, dates and format in a course advert. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: « Il faut » expresses a requirement; « avoir lieu » shows where or when something takes place. In this passage, «formation» means «training».

frases.estudio: Le centre propose une formation de photographie pour les adultes débutants.
frases.alumno: The centre offers a photography course for adult beginners.

frases.estudio: Les cours ont lieu le mardi soir, du 3 novembre au 15 décembre.
frases.alumno: The classes take place on Tuesday evenings, from 3 November to 15 December.
